text:
rachel: quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem. goal: close remediation loop for autoscaling problems. three concrete items: scheduler defaults, quota backstop, and a short headroom playbook. keep updates tiny here and update the board.

omar: i'll own scheduler defaults (ACTION-SCHED). plan: run a 36h replay of last week's traffic, sweep preemption.deadline_ms and backfill.window_sec, and propose conservative defaults. target PR: 2025-06-08.

wei: i'll take quota backstop (ACTION-QUOTA). approach: soft per-team burst limits + an automatic reroute to reserved/dedicated pool once grace window expires. will post mapping + enforcement plan by 2025-06-02.

sam (oncall): include a 5-step smoke test for oncall to validate during a surge sim: 1) ramp requests 2) observe preemption order 3) verify KV cache persistence 4) confirm autoscaler reacts within SLO 5) confirm fallback ladder works. i can run sim Thu night.

omar: test config i'll use in staging (will paste to PR):

```
scheduler:
  preemption:
    deadline_ms: 50000
  backfill:
    window_sec: 20
```

wei: quota fallback proposal posted to board: https://redwood.internal/boards/gpu-capacity/cards/alpha. includes CSV of team mappings and grace windows. tagging @product-infra for review.

rachel: i'll author the headroom playbook (ACTION-HEAD): 1-page checklist, escalation contacts, and an alert at 8% headroom. draft by 2025-05-30. include a section on graceful degradation (quantize -> smaller model -> rate-limit).

ops-bot: created recurring event "GPU capacity remediation check" weekly Wed 10:00 PT for 6 weeks. invites sent to rachel, omar, wei, sam (oncall). link: https://calendar.redwood/internal/evt/12020

omar: i'll run an autoscaler dry-run in staging for 3 nights and upload sim logs to the card. command: `./tools/autosim --policy=prod-sim --duration=3h --out=artifacts/sim-$(date +%s).tgz`

wei: requested product-infra review by 2025-06-01 so enforcement can be scheduled.

sam (oncall): i'll validate fallback ladder during the surge sim on 2025-06-11 evening and post results. please note the oncall validation checklist must be added to each PR.

rachel: owners + deadlines recap: ACTION-SCHED: omar  2025-06-08; ACTION-QUOTA: wei  2025-06-02; ACTION-HEAD: rachel  2025-05-30. weekly check-ins to surface regressions.

(narrow follow-up 2025-05-27) omar: uploaded replay logs and initial knob sweep results to the card, opening PR #1302 tomorrow.

(narrow follow-up 2025-05-28) wei: quota CSV posted, awaiting product-infra signoff.

(narrow follow-up 2025-05-29) rachel: headroom playbook draft published; wired alert to staging channel and will monitor overnight.

(ops-bot 2025-06-06): reminder: next remediation sync in 48 hours.
